name: What documentation is needed to make a cash offer?

mainEntity.name: What documentation is needed to make a cash offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a legitimate cash offer, buyers typically need to provide proof of funds, such as a bank statement or a letter from a financial institution verifying the availability of the cash. This demonstrates to the seller that the buyer has the financial capacity to complete the purchase without external financing. Preparation for buyers involves having these documents readily accessible and up-to-date to submit with their offer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Buyers making a cash offer need to provide proof of funds, like bank statements, to show they have the cash available for the purchase.
